proposals.current: Renders detected spots and their tracks as a color image. It takes a spots collection and, optionally, a reference RGB image, draws the spots on each frame and Z slice, and produces a new RGB image with the same scale. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Converts detected spots and their tracks into a color RGB image. It takes a spots collection and, optionally, a reference RGB image, draws the spots on each frame and Z slice, and produces a new RGB image with the same scale.

proposals.current: Renders measured tracks as a color RGB image, optionally overlaid on a supplied RGB reference image. It takes a track collection and an optional RGB image, draws the tracks on every time and z slice using the track visualization settings and magnification, and produces a new RGB image with the same dimensions and scale. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Converts measured tracks into a color RGB image, optionally overlaid on a supplied RGB reference image. It takes a track collection and an optional RGB image, draws the tracks on every time and z slice using the track visualization settings and magnification, and produces a new RGB image with the same dimensions and scale.

proposals.current: Creates a list for each individual spot
proposals.proposed: Splits a spots collection into a separate list for each individual spot.

proposals.current: Creates a list for each individual track
proposals.proposed: Splits a tracks collection into a separate list for each individual track.

proposals.current: Takes a collection of TrackMate spots and creates a list of 2D ROIs, one ellipse per spot, positioned at the spot's x, y, z, and time coordinates. The ROIs can be named and colored using spot features, and are output as a 2D ROI list for downstream analysis.
proposals.proposed: Converts a collection of TrackMate spots into a list of 2D ROIs, one ellipse per spot positioned at the spot's x, y, z, and time coordinates. The ROIs can be named and colored using spot features, and are output as a 2D ROI list for downstream analysis.

proposals.current: For each track, generates an image that follows the spot over time This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
proposals.proposed: Visualizes tracked spots by generating, for each track, an image that follows the spot over time.
